figures.item: Company car also usable for commuting (§ 8(2) sentence 3 EStG): ADDED to the monthly private-use value, per calendar month, this share of the list price for EACH kilometre of distance between home and first workplace.

figures.item: Tax-free wages for work done from the month AFTER reaching the standard retirement age (§ 3 no. 21 EStG, 'Aktivrente'): up to this amount per YEAR, reduced by one twelfth for each month the conditions are not met, and only where the employer owes pension contributions for that work. figures.item: UG (haftungsbeschränkt): share of yearly profit that must go to the statutory reserve, as the start-up portal prints it. § 5a(3) GmbHG says it in words: one quarter of the annual net profit (Jahresüberschuss) REDUCED by a loss carried forward from the previous year. figures.item: SMALL company (kleine Kapitalgesellschaft, § 267(1) HGB): balance sheet total not exceeded. A capital-market company under § 264d HGB always counts as large.

figures.item: Income tax tariff 2026 (§ 32a(1) EStG): last euro of the second progressive zone. Taxable income, single assessment.

figures.item: Solidarity surcharge 2026, exemption limit (Freigrenze), single assessment (§ 3(3) no. 2 SolzG). The surcharge is charged on a person liable to income tax only if the surcharge base exceeds this amount. The base is the assessed INCOME TAX (computed with the child allowances, less the tax on investment income under § 32d(3) and (4)); it is NOT a limit on income. It is a limit with a mitigation zone above it (pack id de.soli.mitigation-rate), NOT an allowance: above the zone the full rate (pack id de.soli.rate) applies to the whole base. It does NOT apply to corporations, and the surcharge on the investment income tax under § 32d(3) and (4) is charged regardless of it. § 6(27) SolzG: first applies for assessment period 2026; the ministry booklet prints lower 2025 limits.
figures.quote: in anderen Fällen 20 350 Euro übersteigt

figures.item: Solidarity surcharge 2026, exemption limit (Freigrenze) for jointly assessed spouses and the other splitting cases of § 32a(5) and (6) EStG (§ 3(3) no. 1 SolzG). figures.item: Solidarity surcharge mitigation zone (§ 4 sentence 2 SolzG): the surcharge is not more than this share of the DIFFERENCE between the surcharge base and the exemption limit. figures.quote: Er beträgt nicht mehr als 11,9 Prozent des Unterschiedsbetrages

figures.item: Child allowance (Kinderfreibetrag) for the child's material subsistence, § 32(6) sentence 1 EStG: deducted from income for each child that counts, PER PARENT, per year. For spouses assessed jointly the amount DOUBLES if the child is related to both (sentence 2; the statute prints no doubled figure). It is an allowance from income, not a payment. How it is set against child benefit (pack id de.child.benefit.monthly) is ruled in § 31 EStG, which this pack did NOT read: check that page before describing the comparison. It is NOT the total the ministry quotes (pack id de.child.allowance.ministry-total).
figures.quote: ein Freibetrag von 3 414 Euro für das sächliche Existenzminimum des Kindes

figures.item: Allowance for the child's care, upbringing or education needs, § 32(6) sentence 1 EStG: deducted alongside the child allowance, PER PARENT, per year, for each child that counts. Doubles for jointly assessed spouses when the child is related to both (the statute prints no doubled figure).
figures.quote: ein Freibetrag von 1 464 Euro für den Betreuungs- und Erziehungs- oder Ausbildungsbedarf

figures.item: The figure the finance ministry prints as the 2026 'Kinderfreibetrag' on its page about the 2026 changes. It is the PER CHILD TOTAL for both parents together and includes the care allowance; the statute does not print this total, it prints the two per-parent amounts (pack ids de.child.allowance.per-parent and de.child.care-allowance.per-parent). Use it only with that explanation. It is NOT what one parent deducts.
figures.quote: Der Kinderfreibetrag steigt 2026 um 156 Euro auf 9.756 Euro

figures.item: Child benefit (Kindergeld), § 66(1) EStG: paid PER CHILD PER MONTH, the same amount for every child (no higher amount for later children). A monthly payment, not an annual one and not a deduction.
figures.quote: Das Kindergeld beträgt monatlich für jedes Kind 259 Euro

figures.item: Employee lump sum for income-related expenses (Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag), § 9a sentence 1 no. 1(a) EStG: deducted from employment income per year unless higher expenses are proven. It cannot create a loss: deducted only up to the income. It does NOT apply to pension payments from an employer (pack id de.pension-income.lump-sum). Trade union dues are deducted in addition to it (§ 9a sentence 3).
figures.quote: ein Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag von 1 230 Euro

figures.item: Lump sum for income-related expenses on employer pension payments (Versorgungsbezüge, § 19(2) EStG), § 9a sentence 1 no. 1(b) EStG. Per year. The same amount is printed a second time in § 9a for a different rule (pack id de.other-income.lump-sum): do not merge them.
figures.quote: handelt: ein Pauschbetrag von 102 Euro

figures.item: Lump sum for income-related expenses on income under § 22 no. 1, 1a and 5 EStG, § 9a sentence 1 no. 3 EStG (no. 1a is what a recipient gets under § 10(1a), for example maintenance from an ex-spouse who deducts it). ONE amount in total per year for all such income together, not one per source. Deducted only up to the income.
figures.quote: ein Pauschbetrag von insgesamt 102 Euro

figures.item: Commuting allowance (Entfernungspauschale) 2026, § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 4 EStG: per FULL KILOMETRE of the one-way distance between home and first place of work, per working day on which the workplace is visited. Changed for 2026: one single rate from the FIRST kilometre. The old two-step rule (a lower rate for the first twenty kilometres) is gone and must not appear. One-way distance, not the round trip. Not for flights. Also used for business owners' trips to the business premises (§ 4(5) no. 6 EStG). It is NOT the business-trip mileage rate (pack id de.business-trip.car-rate).
figures.quote: von 0,38 Euro anzusetzen, höchstens jedoch 4 500 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Yearly cap on the commuting allowance, § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 4 EStG. Per calendar year. The cap does NOT apply to the extent the employee uses their own car or a car provided to them: then a higher amount is allowed.
figures.quote: höchstens jedoch 4 500 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Second household for work (doppelte Haushaltsführung): rate per full kilometre of the one-way distance for the trip home to the main household, § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 5 EStG. Only ONE trip home PER WEEK counts. Same number as the commuting rate but a separate rule. Trips in a motor vehicle provided to the taxpayer as part of an income type are not counted.
figures.quote: eine Entfernungspauschale von 0,38 Euro für jeden vollen Kilometer

figures.item: Second household for work: cap on the actual cost of the accommodation when it is IN GERMANY, § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 5 EStG. PER MONTH, actual costs up to the cap, not a flat amount.
figures.quote: höchstens 1 000 Euro im Monat bei einer Unterkunft im Inland

figures.item: Second household for work: cap on the actual cost of the accommodation when it is ABROAD, § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 5 EStG. PER MONTH. The cap does not apply where an official or company flat must be used or the cost is recognised as necessary for the rent subsidy under § 54 of the federal pay act.
figures.quote: höchstens 2 000 Euro im Monat bei einer Unterkunft im Ausland

figures.item: Business trips (NOT commuting) by car: flat rate per kilometre DRIVEN that may be used in place of actual costs. § 9(1) sentence 3 no. 4a EStG points to the highest mileage allowance of the federal travel cost act; § 5(2) of that act prints this rate for a car. The page prints CENTS, so a Guide must write it as cents: an amount written as a euro decimal is not on the page. For other motor vehicles the same act prints a lower rate. Every kilometre driven counts, unlike the commuting allowance, which counts the one-way distance.
figures.quote: beträgt die Wegstreckenentschädigung 30 Cent je Kilometer zurückgelegter Strecke

figures.item: Home office ROOM that is the centre of all business and professional activity, § 4(5) no. 6b EStG: yearly flat amount that may be taken IN PLACE OF the actual costs. Per business or calendar year; reduced by one twelfth for each full month in which the room is not the centre. A room that is not the centre gives no room deduction at all. Same number as the day-rate cap (pack id de.home-office.day-cap) but a different rule.
figures.quote: pauschal ein Betrag von 1 260 Euro (Jahrespauschale)

figures.item: Home working day rate (Tagespauschale), § 4(5) no. 6c EStG: per CALENDAR DAY on which the work is done mainly at home and no first place of work outside the home is visited. Covers the whole business and professional activity (one rate per day, not one per job). No separate room is needed. Not available for a day when the room costs of no. 6b or a second household's accommodation are deducted.
figures.quote: ein Betrag von 6 Euro (Tagespauschale)

figures.item: Yearly cap on the home working day rates, § 4(5) no. 6c EStG. Per business or calendar year, per person.
figures.quote: höchstens 1 260 Euro im Wirtschafts- oder Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Meal flat amount for work away from home and first place of work, IN GERMANY, § 9(4a) sentence 3 no. 1 EStG: for each calendar day with 24 hours' absence. Foreign trips use country amounts set by the ministry, not this. Limited to the first three months at the same place of work.
figures.quote: 28 Euro für jeden Kalendertag

figures.item: Meal flat amount, IN GERMANY, § 9(4a) sentence 3 no. 2 EStG: for the day of arrival and the day of departure EACH, when the person stays overnight away from home on that day or the day before or after. No minimum hours.
figures.quote: jeweils 14 Euro für den An- und Abreisetag

figures.item: Meal flat amount, IN GERMANY, § 9(4a) sentence 3 no. 3 EStG: for a calendar day WITHOUT overnight stay with more than eight hours' absence from home and first place of work. Eight hours or less gives nothing.
figures.quote: 14 Euro für den Kalendertag, an dem der Arbeitnehmer ohne Übernachtung

figures.item: Meal flat amount is cut when the employer (or a third party at the employer's instance) provides a meal, § 9(4a) sentence 8 EStG: cut for BREAKFAST, as a share of the FULL-DAY amount (pack id de.meals.full-day), not of the amount for that day. The cut cannot exceed the day's amount.
figures.quote: für Frühstück um 20 Prozent

figures.item: Cut of the meal flat amount for a provided LUNCH and for a provided DINNER, EACH, § 9(4a) sentence 8 EStG, as a share of the FULL-DAY amount.
figures.quote: für Mittag- und Abendessen um jeweils 40 Prozent

figures.item: Special expenses lump sum (Sonderausgaben-Pauschbetrag), § 10c EStG: deducted per year for the special expenses of § 10(1) no. 4, 5, 7 and 9, § 10(1a) and § 10b unless higher expenses are proven. It doubles for jointly assessed spouses (the statute prints no doubled figure). It does NOT cover pension or insurance contributions.
figures.quote: wird ein Pauschbetrag von 36 Euro abgezogen (Sonderausgaben-Pauschbetrag)

figures.item: Childcare costs as special expenses, § 10(1) no. 5 EStG: deductible SHARE of the cost of care services for a child of the household under 14 (or disabled before 25). Needs an invoice AND payment to the provider's account (no cash). Not for tuition, sport or leisure activities.
figures.quote: 80 Prozent der Aufwendungen, höchstens 4 800 Euro je Kind

figures.item: Childcare costs as special expenses, § 10(1) no. 5 EStG: yearly cap on the DEDUCTION, PER CHILD. It caps the deductible share, not the cost.
figures.quote: höchstens 4 800 Euro je Kind

figures.item: Cost of one's OWN vocational training (Berufsausbildung) as special expenses, § 10(1) no. 7 EStG: cap per calendar year. For spouses it applies to EACH spouse. Includes the cost of living away from home for the training.
figures.quote: Aufwendungen für die eigene Berufsausbildung bis zu 6 000 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Private school fees as special expenses, § 10(1) no. 9 EStG: deductible SHARE of the fee for a child for whom child benefit or the child allowance is due. The fee excludes boarding, care and meals.
figures.quote: 30 Prozent des Entgelts, höchstens 5 000 Euro

figures.item: Private school fees, § 10(1) no. 9 EStG: yearly cap on the DEDUCTION, per child.
figures.quote: höchstens 5 000 Euro, das der Steuerpflichtige für ein Kind

figures.item: Maintenance paid to a divorced or permanently separated spouse who is fully liable to German tax, § 10(1a) no. 1 EStG (Realsplitting): cap per calendar year. Only on the payer's application WITH the recipient's consent; the recipient then pays tax on it. The cap rises by the basic health and care insurance contributions paid for the recipient.
figures.quote: bis zu 13 805 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Cap per calendar year on the provident expenses of § 10(1) no. 3 and 3a EStG together (health and long-term care insurance plus other insurance), § 10(4) sentence 1 EStG, for people who do not fall under sentence 2 (pack id de.insurance.other.cap-reduced). If the basic health and care contributions of no. 3 alone exceed the cap they are deducted in full and nothing is left for the no. 3a insurance. Pension contributions are NOT under this cap. Jointly assessed spouses: the sum of each spouse's own cap.
figures.quote: können je Kalenderjahr insgesamt bis 2 800 Euro abgezogen werden

figures.item: Lower cap of § 10(4) sentence 2 EStG for people who have a claim to full or partial reimbursement or cover of sickness costs without own expense, or for whose health insurance tax-free payments under § 3 no. 9, 14, 57 or 62 EStG are made (no. 62 is the employer's contribution for an employee). Same rule otherwise as pack id de.insurance.other.cap.
figures.quote: Der Höchstbetrag beträgt 1 900 Euro bei Steuerpflichtigen

figures.item: Donations and membership fees to tax-privileged bodies, § 10b(1) EStG: deductible as special expenses up to this share of TOTAL INCOME (Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte) per year. The alternative cap is a per-mille share of turnover plus wages. Party donations follow a separate rule.
figures.quote: 20 Prozent des Gesamtbetrags der Einkünfte

figures.item: Relief for single parents (Entlastungsbetrag für Alleinerziehende), § 24b(2) EStG: deducted per calendar year when at least one child with child benefit or the child allowance belongs to the household. For the FIRST child. Not for anyone who qualifies for splitting or who shares the household with another adult.
figures.quote: beträgt der Entlastungsbetrag im Kalenderjahr 4 260 Euro

figures.item: Single parent relief, § 24b(2) EStG: increase for EACH FURTHER child of the household, per calendar year.
figures.quote: um 240 Euro je weiterem Kind

figures.item: Tax credit for household employment, household services and tradespeople's work in the taxpayer's own household, § 35a EStG: share of the cost that is taken off the TAX (not off income). The same share is printed for all three kinds; each has its own cap. Only on application, only for a household in the EU or EEA, not for costs that are business expenses.
figures.quote: auf Antrag um 20 Prozent, höchstens 510 Euro

figures.item: § 35a(1) EStG: yearly cap on the tax credit for a household MINI-JOB (marginal employment in the household).
figures.quote: höchstens 510 Euro, der Aufwendungen des Steuerpflichtigen

figures.item: § 35a(2) EStG: yearly cap on the tax credit for OTHER household employment and household services, including care services. Does not cover tradespeople's work.
figures.quote: höchstens 4 000 Euro, der Aufwendungen des Steuerpflichtigen

figures.item: § 35a(3) EStG: yearly cap on the tax credit for TRADESPEOPLE'S work on renovation, maintenance and modernisation. Not for publicly subsidised measures. It caps the credit, not the cost.
figures.quote: höchstens jedoch um 1 200 Euro

figures.item: Employees, § 46(2) no. 1 EStG: an income tax assessment is COMPULSORY if the positive sum of income that was not subject to wage tax, or the positive sum of income and benefits subject to the progression clause, is MORE THAN this amount. It is a filing trigger, not an exemption. The same number is used again for the hardship relief (pack id de.side-income.hardship-limit).
figures.quote: jeweils mehr als 410 Euro beträgt

figures.item: Employees who are assessed, § 46(3) EStG: side income without wage tax is deducted from income, so it stays untaxed, if it is NOT MORE THAN this amount IN TOTAL. Above it, § 46(5) phases in full taxation. Only for people with employment income; it is NOT a general allowance for the self-employed.
figures.quote: insgesamt nicht mehr als 410 Euro betragen

figures.item: Loss carry-back, § 10d(1) EStG: losses not offset in the year are carried back up to this amount, first to the year immediately before, then to the second year before. Single assessment. The taxpayer may waive the carry-back, but only as a whole.
figures.quote: bis zu einem Betrag von 1 000 000 Euro

figures.item: Loss carry-back cap for jointly assessed spouses, § 10d(1) EStG. Per couple.
figures.quote: bis zu einem Betrag von 2 000 000 Euro

figures.item: Loss carry-forward, § 10d(2) EStG: losses are deducted without limit up to a base of total income, and ABOVE that base only up to this share of the excess. The statute prints the base in WORDS ('1 Million Euro', and '2 Millionen Euro' for jointly assessed spouses): write it in words. This is the income tax share; trade tax has its own lower share (pack id de.trade-tax.loss.share-above-base).
figures.quote: bis zu 70 Prozent des 1 Million Euro übersteigenden Gesamtbetrags der Einkünfte

figures.item: Sale or closure of a business, § 16(4) EStG: the gain is taxed only above this amount, ON APPLICATION, if the seller has reached age 55 OR is permanently unable to work. ONCE IN A LIFETIME. It shrinks above the gain in pack id de.business-sale.allowance-taper.
figures.quote: soweit er 45 000 Euro übersteigt

figures.item: § 16(4) EStG: the business sale allowance is reduced by the amount by which the gain exceeds this figure.
figures.quote: um den der Veräußerungsgewinn 136 000 Euro übersteigt

figures.item: Special income tax rate for RETAINED (not withdrawn) profits of sole traders and partners, on application, § 34a(1) EStG, for assessment periods up to 2027. Only for profit computed by balance sheet (§ 4(1) or § 5), so NOT for cash-basis (EÜR) businesses. A partner needs a profit share above 10 percent or above the amount the section prints. Later withdrawal triggers a follow-up tax (pack id de.retained-profit.follow-up-rate). The section prints lower rates for later years.
figures.quote: 28,25 Prozent für Veranlagungszeiträume bis 2027

figures.item: § 34a(4) EStG: income tax rate on the follow-up amount when previously favoured retained profits are withdrawn.
figures.quote: Die Einkommensteuer auf den Nachversteuerungsbetrag beträgt 25 Prozent

figures.item: Gifts to people who are NOT the taxpayer's employees, § 4(5) no. 1 EStG: deductible only if the cost of ALL items given to one recipient in the business year does not exceed this amount. A CLIFF per recipient per year: one euro over and the whole cost of the gifts to that person is non-deductible.
figures.quote: insgesamt 50 Euro nicht übersteigen

figures.item: Business entertainment of people for a business reason, § 4(5) no. 2 EStG: share of the REASONABLE and DOCUMENTED cost that is deductible. The rest is not. Needs written details of place, date, participants, reason and amount; a restaurant bill must be attached.
figures.quote: soweit sie 70 Prozent der Aufwendungen übersteigen

figures.item: Business entertainment: the non-deductible share, as printed in the ministry's 2026 instructions for the EÜR form (the statute prints only the deductible share).
figures.quote: sind zu 70 % abziehbar und zu 30 % nicht abziehbar

figures.item: Over-withdrawals, § 4(4a) EStG: non-deductible loan interest is set at this flat share of the over-withdrawal of the year plus earlier over-withdrawals less earlier under-withdrawals. Interest on loans for fixed assets is not affected.
figures.quote: typisiert mit 6 Prozent der Überentnahme des Wirtschaftsjahres

figures.item: Over-withdrawals, § 4(4a) EStG: the add-back is at most the year's loan interest LESS this amount, so this much interest per year is always left deductible.
figures.quote: höchstens jedoch der um 2 050 Euro verminderte Betrag

figures.item: Low-value assets (GWG), § 6(2) EStG: a movable, depreciable fixed asset that can be used on its own may be expensed in full in the year of purchase if its cost, LESS any input VAT amount contained in it (§ 9b(1) EStG), does not exceed this amount. PER ASSET. A choice, not a duty.
figures.quote: für das einzelne Wirtschaftsgut 800 Euro nicht übersteigen

figures.item: Low-value assets, § 6(2) sentence 4 EStG: an asset expensed at once whose value is ABOVE this amount must be entered in a special running register with date and cost (not needed if the books already show it). The same number is also the lower bound of the pool (pack id de.gwg.pool.lower).
figures.quote: deren Wert 250 Euro übersteigt

figures.item: Pool method (Sammelposten), § 6(2a) EStG: assets costing MORE THAN this amount (net of input VAT) may go into a yearly pool. If the pool is chosen, assets up to this amount may still be expensed at once, and the choice must be used for ALL such assets of the year. The pool is released over the year it is formed and the following four years, one fifth each (the statute prints the fraction in words).
figures.quote: für das einzelne Wirtschaftsgut 250 Euro, aber nicht 1 000 Euro übersteigen

figures.item: Pool method, § 6(2a) EStG: upper cost bound per asset (net of input VAT). An asset that leaves the business does not reduce the pool.
figures.quote: 250 Euro, aber nicht 1 000 Euro übersteigen

figures.item: Declining-balance depreciation for movable fixed assets, § 7(2) EStG: the rate may be at most three times the straight-line rate (words in the statute) AND may not exceed this cap. ONLY for assets bought or made after 30 June 2025 and before 1 January 2028 (both dates must hold). Assets outside that window get straight-line only.
figures.quote: und 30 Prozent nicht übersteigen

figures.item: Electric vehicles that are fixed assets, bought after 30 June 2025 and before 1 January 2028 (both dates must hold), § 7(2a) EStG: share of cost deductible in the YEAR OF PURCHASE. The statute prints the later years' shares in WORDS, so only this one is a digit. Not together with special depreciation.
figures.quote: im Jahr der Anschaffung 75 Prozent

figures.item: Yearly straight-line depreciation of a building that is a BUSINESS asset and NOT used for housing, building application after 31 March 1985, § 7(4) sentence 1 no. 1 EStG. On the building's cost. FIRST YEAR: straight-line building depreciation is cut by months in the year of purchase or completion (finance ministry letter of 21 May 2025 on § 7b EStG, example 7: "bei Fertigstellung nach dem 31. Januar wäre eine zeitanteilige Kürzung der linearen AfA im Jahr der Fertigstellung erforderlich"). Only the old staged rates of § 7(5) EStG are taken in full in the first year (§ 7(5) sentence 3).
figures.quote: gestellt worden ist, jährlich 3 Prozent

figures.item: Yearly straight-line depreciation of any OTHER building (for example rented housing) completed after 31 December 2022, § 7(4) sentence 1 no. 2(a) EStG. The test is the completion date, not the purchase date. FIRST YEAR: straight-line building depreciation is cut by months in the year of purchase or completion (finance ministry letter of 21 May 2025 on § 7b EStG, example 7: "bei Fertigstellung nach dem 31. Januar wäre eine zeitanteilige Kürzung der linearen AfA im Jahr der Fertigstellung erforderlich"). Only the old staged rates of § 7(5) EStG are taken in full in the first year (§ 7(5) sentence 3).
figures.quote: 31. Dezember 2022 fertiggestellt worden sind, jährlich 3 Prozent

figures.item: Yearly straight-line depreciation of any other building completed before 1 January 2023 and after 31 December 1924 (both dates must hold), § 7(4) sentence 1 no. 2(b) EStG. This is the rate for most existing rented homes. FIRST YEAR: straight-line building depreciation is cut by months in the year of purchase or completion (finance ministry letter of 21 May 2025 on § 7b EStG, example 7: "bei Fertigstellung nach dem 31. Januar wäre eine zeitanteilige Kürzung der linearen AfA im Jahr der Fertigstellung erforderlich"). Only the old staged rates of § 7(5) EStG are taken in full in the first year (§ 7(5) sentence 3).
figures.quote: 31. Dezember 1924 fertiggestellt worden sind, jährlich 2 Prozent

figures.item: Yearly straight-line depreciation of any other building completed before 1 January 1925, § 7(4) sentence 1 no. 2(c) EStG. FIRST YEAR: straight-line building depreciation is cut by months in the year of purchase or completion (finance ministry letter of 21 May 2025 on § 7b EStG, example 7: "bei Fertigstellung nach dem 31. Januar wäre eine zeitanteilige Kürzung der linearen AfA im Jahr der Fertigstellung erforderlich"). Only the old staged rates of § 7(5) EStG are taken in full in the first year (§ 7(5) sentence 3).
figures.quote: 1. Januar 1925 fertiggestellt worden sind, jährlich 2,5 Prozent

figures.item: Declining-balance depreciation for RESIDENTIAL buildings in the EU or EEA, § 7(5a) EStG: fixed rate on the remaining book value, as a choice in place of the straight-line rate. ONLY if construction began after 30 September 2023 and before 1 October 2029, or the purchase contract was made in that window and the building is bought by the end of the year of completion. No extraordinary write-down alongside. Switch to straight-line is allowed.
figures.quote: Prozentsatz in Höhe von 5 Prozent vom jeweiligen Buchwert (Restwert)

figures.item: Special depreciation for NEW rental housing, § 7b(1) EStG: up to this share of the assessment base PER YEAR, in the year of purchase or completion and the following three years, ON TOP OF normal depreciation. The flat must be let for housing for that year and the nine following years, or the relief is reversed. Subject to the EU de minimis rules.
figures.quote: Sonderabschreibungen bis zu jährlich 5 Prozent der Bemessungsgrundlage

figures.item: § 7b(2) EStG, NEW window (building application or notice after 31 December 2022 and before 1 October 2029): cost per square metre of living space that must not be exceeded. A CLIFF: above it there is no special depreciation at all. The building must also meet the 'Effizienzhaus 40' standard with the sustainability seal.
figures.quote: 5 200 Euro je Quadratmeter Wohnfläche nicht übersteigen

figures.item: § 7b(3) EStG, NEW window: highest cost per square metre of living space that counts as the assessment base. A cap on the base, not a cliff.
figures.quote: maximal 4 000 Euro je Quadratmeter Wohnfläche

figures.item: § 7b(2) EStG, OLD window (building application after 31 August 2018 and before 1 January 2022): cost cliff per square metre. § 52(15a) EStG: the old-window relief can be claimed for the last time for assessment period 2026.
figures.quote: 3 000 Euro je Quadratmeter Wohnfläche nicht übersteigen

figures.item: § 7b(3) EStG, OLD window (application after 31 August 2018 and before 1 January 2022): highest cost per square metre that counts as the assessment base.
figures.quote: maximal 2 000 Euro je Quadratmeter Wohnfläche

figures.item: Investment deduction (Investitionsabzugsbetrag), § 7g(1) EStG: share of the EXPECTED cost of a future movable fixed asset that may be deducted from profit in advance. The asset must be used (almost) only for the business, or let, until the end of the year after purchase. The same share is added back in the year of purchase.
figures.quote: bis zu 50 Prozent der voraussichtlichen Anschaffungs- oder Herstellungskosten

figures.item: § 7g(1) sentence 2 no. 1(b) EStG: the investment deduction is allowed only if the PROFIT of the business year in which it is claimed, computed WITHOUT the deduction, does not exceed this amount. A cliff. Applies to balance-sheet and cash-basis businesses alike. The same number is printed again as the total cap (pack id de.investment-deduction.total-cap): two different rules.
figures.quote: 200 000 Euro nicht überschreitet

figures.item: § 7g(1) sentence 4 EStG: the SUM of investment deductions of the year and the three preceding years that have not been added back or reversed may not exceed this amount, PER BUSINESS. Not a profit limit.
figures.quote: darf je Betrieb 200 000 Euro nicht übersteigen

figures.item: Special depreciation for small businesses, § 7g(5) EStG: up to this share of cost IN TOTAL, spread freely over the year of purchase and the four following years, ON TOP OF normal depreciation. Only if the profit of the year BEFORE the purchase did not exceed the profit limit (pack id de.investment-deduction.profit-limit). § 52(16) EStG: this rate is for assets bought or made after 31 December 2023; the page does not print the earlier rate.
figures.quote: Sonderabschreibungen bis zu insgesamt 40 Prozent der Anschaffungs- oder Herstellungskosten

figures.item: Company car, § 6(1) no. 4 sentence 2 EStG: the list-price method for private use applies only to a vehicle used MORE THAN this share for the business. At or below it the list-price method is not available.
figures.quote: das zu mehr als 50 Prozent betrieblich genutzt wird

figures.item: Company car, § 6(1) no. 4 sentence 2 EStG: private use is valued PER CALENDAR MONTH at this share of the German LIST PRICE at first registration, plus optional extras, INCLUDING VAT. List price, never the price paid. The logbook method is the alternative.
figures.quote: für jeden Kalendermonat mit 1 Prozent des inländischen Listenpreises

figures.item: Business owner's trips between home and business premises in a car valued by the list-price method, § 4(5) no. 6 EStG: non-deductible amount is this share of the list price PER CALENDAR MONTH PER KILOMETRE of distance, less the commuting allowance.
figures.quote: 0,03 Prozent des inländischen Listenpreises

figures.item: § 4(5) no. 6 EStG: for trips home within a second household, this share of the list price PER KILOMETRE of distance per trip, less the allowance for such trips.
figures.quote: 0,002 Prozent des inländischen Listenpreises

figures.item: Electric company car, § 6(1) no. 4 sentence 2 no. 3 EStG: a car with NO CO2 emissions bought after 31 December 2018 and before 1 January 2031 has only ONE QUARTER of its list price counted for private use if the GROSS list price is not more than this amount. The statute prints the fraction in WORDS ('nur zu einem Viertel'): write 'one quarter', never a percentage. § 52(12) EStG: this limit is for cars bought after 30 June 2025; the page does NOT print the lower limits for cars bought earlier, so do not state them. Where the quarter rule does not apply, a car bought after 31 December 2024 and before 1 January 2031 has HALF its list price counted (words again: 'zur Hälfte') if it emits at most 50 grams of CO2 per kilometre OR has an electric range of at least 80 kilometres; the statute prints no price limit for the half rule.
figures.quote: nicht mehr als 100 000 Euro beträgt

figures.item: Tax balance sheet, § 6(1) no. 3a(e) EStG: provisions for obligations are discounted at this rate. NOT for provisions with a term under twelve months at the balance sheet date, nor for interest-bearing ones or ones based on an advance payment. A rule for the tax balance sheet.
figures.quote: mit einem Zinssatz von 5,5 Prozent abzuzinsen

figures.item: Interest barrier (Zinsschranke), § 4h(1) EStG: net interest expense is deductible only up to this share of tax EBITDA. The exemption threshold is printed in WORDS ('drei Millionen Euro' of net interest expense): write it in words.
figures.quote: Das verrechenbare EBITDA ist 30 Prozent

figures.item: VAT standard rate, § 12(1) UStG: on every taxable supply, on the net amount.
figures.quote: Die Steuer beträgt für jeden steuerpflichtigen Umsatz 19 Prozent der Bemessungsgrundlage

figures.item: VAT reduced rate. The statute (§ 12(2) UStG) prints it in WORDS ('sieben Prozent'); the digit is printed in the ministry booklet, 2025 edition, which is the page to link. Applies only to the supplies listed in § 12(2) UStG and its annex.
figures.tax_year: 2025 edition of the ministry booklet (Stand Januar 2025); the statute in force in 2026 prints the same rate in words
figures.quote: den ermäßigten von 7 Prozent

figures.item: VAT zero rate, § 12(3) UStG: for the supply and installation of solar modules, essential components and storage to the operator of a photovoltaic system on or near homes and buildings used for public-benefit activities. The statute calls it a RATE of 0 percent, not an exemption. The conditions count as met when the system's registered gross output is not more than 30 kilowatts peak. The paragraph also covers the intra-Community purchase, import and installation of those items, and nothing else.
figures.quote: Die Steuer ermäßigt sich auf 0 Prozent für die folgenden Umsätze

figures.item: Restaurant and catering services: from 1 January 2026 the VAT on FOOD falls to the reduced rate. DRINKS stay at the standard rate. Source is the ministry's page on the 2026 changes. Same number as the general reduced rate, but a rule with a start date: meals served before 2026 were at the standard rate.
figures.quote: sinkt zum 1. Januar 2026 von 19 auf 7 Prozent

figures.item: Small business (Kleinunternehmer), § 19(1) UStG: total turnover of the PREVIOUS calendar year must NOT have exceeded this amount. Condition 1 of 2, joined by AND with pack id de.vat.small-business.current-year. Total turnover is defined in § 19(2): receipts basis, without certain exempt supplies and without sales of fixed assets. The statute makes the small business's supplies tax-free (steuerfrei). Older Guides state lower limits: they are wrong.
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr 25 000 Euro nicht überschritten hat

figures.item: Small business, § 19(1) UStG: total turnover of the CURRENT calendar year must NOT exceed this amount. Condition 2 of 2 (AND). It is a hard limit during the year, not a forecast: the ministry's 2026 EÜR instructions say the very receipt that crosses the limit is already taxed under the normal rules, and receipts before it stay exempt.
figures.quote: im laufenden Kalenderjahr 100 000 Euro nicht überschreitet

figures.item: Small business that STARTS during the year: total turnover of the current calendar year must not exceed this amount, as printed in the ministry's 2026 instructions for the EÜR form. It is the actual turnover, not an annualised forecast. The receipt that crosses the limit is already taxed.
figures.quote: darf der Gesamtumsatz im laufenden Kj. 25.000 € nicht überschreiten

figures.item: Business established in ANOTHER EU member state that wants the German small-business exemption, § 19(4) UStG: its annual turnover in the WHOLE EU must not have exceeded this amount in the previous calendar year AND must not exceed it in the current year, and it needs a small-business identification number from its home state. Same number as the German current-year limit but an EU-wide test.
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr 100 000 Euro nicht überschritten hat

figures.item: VAT advance returns, § 18(2) UStG: quarterly by default; MONTHLY if the VAT PAYABLE for the PREVIOUS calendar year was MORE THAN this amount. The test is the VAT, not turnover. A new business files monthly in its first and second year regardless; for 2021 to 2026 a special rule annualises or forecasts the tax instead.
figures.quote: für das vorangegangene Kalenderjahr mehr als 9 000 Euro

figures.item: VAT advance returns, § 18(2) UStG: if the VAT for the previous calendar year was NOT MORE THAN this amount the tax office MAY release the business from advance returns and prepayments. Discretionary, not automatic; the annual return is still due.
figures.quote: für das vorangegangene Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 2 000 Euro

figures.item: VAT advance returns, § 18(2a) UStG: a business may CHOOSE monthly returns if the previous calendar year ended with a SURPLUS IN ITS FAVOUR of more than this amount. The choice is made by filing the January return by 10 February and binds for that calendar year. Same number as pack id de.vat.returns.monthly-above, opposite direction.
figures.quote: ein Überschuss zu seinen Gunsten von mehr als 9 000 Euro

figures.item: VAT cash accounting (tax on RECEIPTS rather than on invoices), § 20 no. 1 UStG: the tax office may allow it ON APPLICATION if total turnover of the PREVIOUS calendar year was not more than this amount. Alternative grounds, joined by OR: release from bookkeeping duty, or a liberal profession (then no turnover limit).
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 800 000 Euro betragen hat

figures.item: Small-amount invoices, § 33 UStDV: an invoice whose TOTAL (gross) amount does not exceed this needs only: the supplier's full name and address, the issue date, quantity and kind of goods or scope and kind of service, and the price and tax in ONE sum with the tax rate (or a note that an exemption applies). NOT for supplies under § 3c, § 6a and § 13b UStG (distance sales, intra-Community supplies, reverse charge). Such an invoice may always be sent as an 'other invoice' under § 14(1) sentence 4 UStG, so it is outside the e-invoice duty.
figures.quote: Eine Rechnung, deren Gesamtbetrag 250 Euro nicht übersteigt

figures.item: E-invoicing transition, § 27(38) no. 2 UStG: for supplies made in 2027, the ISSUER may still send paper or (with consent) another electronic format until 31 December 2027 only if ITS total turnover of the PREVIOUS calendar year was not more than this amount. For supplies made in 2025 and 2026 every issuer may still do so until 31 December 2026, with no turnover test. This paragraph is about ISSUING only.
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht mehr als 800 000 Euro betragen hat

figures.item: EU threshold, § 3c(4) UStG: a business established in ONLY ONE member state keeps the place of supply at home if the TOTAL of its cross-border distance sales of goods AND its telecom, broadcasting and electronic services to consumers in other member states did not exceed this amount in the previous calendar year AND does not exceed it in the current year. EU-wide total, not per country. Can be waived, binding for two calendar years. It is NOT a threshold for domestic German sales and not a registration limit.
figures.quote: insgesamt 10 000 Euro im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr nicht überschritten hat

figures.item: Recapitulative statement (Zusammenfassende Meldung), § 18a(1) UStG: MONTHLY by default for intra-Community supplies of goods; QUARTERLY is allowed while the total of such supplies is not more than this amount in the current quarter AND in each of the four previous quarters. Once a quarter exceeds it, monthly filing starts with the month of the excess. Services under § 3a(2) are reported quarterly regardless (§ 18a(2)).
figures.quote: jeweils mehr als 50 000 Euro beträgt

figures.item: Recapitulative statement filed YEARLY, § 18a(9) UStG: only for a business released from VAT advance returns, and only if ALL supplies of the previous calendar year did not exceed this amount and are not expected to in the current year. Condition 1 of 3 (AND).
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr 200 000 Euro nicht überstiegen hat

figures.item: Yearly recapitulative statement, § 18a(9) UStG: intra-Community supplies of goods and reverse-charge services in other member states of the previous calendar year did not exceed this amount and are not expected to in the current year. Condition 2 of 3 (AND); condition 3 is no new vehicles to buyers with a VAT number.
figures.quote: im vorangegangenen Kalenderjahr 15 000 Euro nicht überstiegen hat

figures.item: Trade tax allowance, § 11(1) GewStG: taken off the trade income of NATURAL PERSONS AND PARTNERSHIPS, per business per year, after rounding the trade income down to full hundreds of euros. NOT for corporations (a GmbH gets no allowance). An allowance, not a cliff.
figures.quote: um einen Freibetrag in Höhe von 24 500 Euro

figures.item: Trade tax allowance, § 11(1) no. 2 GewStG: for associations with a commercial operation, certain exempt bodies and businesses of public-law bodies. NOT for a GmbH, AG or other corporation outside that list.
figures.quote: um einen Freibetrag in Höhe von 5 000 Euro

figures.item: Trade tax base rate (Steuermesszahl), § 11(2) GewStG: applied to trade income after the allowance to get the base amount (Steuermessbetrag). It is NOT the trade tax rate: the tax is the base amount times the municipal multiplier. Never multiply it out into an 'effective rate'.
figures.quote: Die Steuermesszahl für den Gewerbeertrag beträgt 3,5 Prozent

figures.item: Trade tax add-backs, § 8 no. 1 GewStG: the financing items (interest, rents, leases, licence fees, each at its own share) are summed, this allowance is taken off the SUM, and one quarter of the rest is added back. The statute prints every share in WORDS ('ein Viertel', 'ein Fünftel', 'die Hälfte'): write them in words, never as percentages. Per business per year.
figures.quote: soweit die Summe den Betrag von 200 000 Euro übersteigt

figures.item: Lowest municipal trade tax multiplier (Hebesatz) that applies for collection period 2026. WARNING: the statute page (§ 16(4) GewStG) today prints a HIGHER figure, but § 36(5b) GewStG says that version first applies for collection period 2027 (pack id de.trade-tax.multiplier.minimum.from-2027). The 2026 figure is printed only in the ministry booklet, 2025 edition. Each municipality sets its own, higher multiplier: this is only the floor.
figures.tax_year: 2025 edition of the ministry booklet (Stand Januar 2025); still the rule for collection period 2026 because § 36(5b) GewStG starts the new figure in 2027
figures.quote: Er beträgt mindestens 200 Prozent

figures.item: Lowest municipal trade tax multiplier from collection period 2027 onward, § 16(4) sentence 2 GewStG as amended by the law of 29 June 2026; § 36(5b) GewStG gives the start. NOT the 2026 figure. A Guide for tax year 2026 may mention it only as a future change.
figures.quote: Er beträgt 280 Prozent, wenn die Gemeinde nicht einen höheren Hebesatz bestimmt hat

figures.item: Trade tax loss carry-forward, § 10a GewStG: losses reduce trade income without limit up to a base the statute prints in WORDS ('1 Million Euro'), and ABOVE it only up to this share. There is NO carry-back for trade tax. This share is LOWER than the income tax share (pack id de.loss.carryforward.share-above-base): do not mix them.
figures.quote: ist bis zu 60 Prozent um nach Satz 1 nicht berücksichtigte Fehlbeträge

figures.item: Trade tax prepayments, § 19(5) GewStG: a single prepayment is set only if it is at least this amount.
figures.quote: Sie wird nur festgesetzt, wenn sie mindestens 50 Euro beträgt

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate for 2026, § 23(1) no. 1 KStG: the statute prints it for assessment periods UP TO 2027, on taxable income. Solidarity surcharge (pack id de.soli.rate, no exemption limit for corporations) and trade tax come on top; never add them into one combined rate. The same section schedules yearly cuts from 2028 (pack ids de.corp-tax.rate.2028 to de.corp-tax.rate.from-2032): none of them applies to 2026.
figures.quote: Veranlagungszeiträume bis 2027 15 Prozent

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate scheduled for assessment period 2028 only, § 23(1) no. 2 KStG. NOT the 2026 rate.
figures.quote: den Veranlagungszeitraum 2028 14 Prozent

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate scheduled for assessment period 2029 only, § 23(1) no. 3 KStG. NOT the 2026 rate.
figures.quote: den Veranlagungszeitraum 2029 13 Prozent

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate scheduled for assessment period 2030 only, § 23(1) no. 4 KStG. NOT the 2026 rate.
figures.quote: den Veranlagungszeitraum 2030 12 Prozent

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate scheduled for assessment period 2031 only, § 23(1) no. 5 KStG. NOT the 2026 rate.
figures.quote: den Veranlagungszeitraum 2031 11 Prozent

figures.item: Corporate income tax rate scheduled for assessment periods from 2032 onward, § 23(1) no. 6 KStG. NOT the 2026 rate.
figures.quote: Veranlagungszeiträume ab 2032 10 Prozent

figures.item: Corporations holding shares, § 8b(3) and (5) KStG: dividends and gains on shares are left out of income, but this share of them counts as NON-DEDUCTIBLE expense. The number is printed twice, once for gains (paragraph 3) and once for dividends (paragraph 5). For dividends the exemption needs the minimum holding in pack id de.corp-tax.participation.min-holding. Never state the result as a computed 'exempt' percentage.
figures.quote: gelten 5 Prozent als Ausgaben, die nicht als Betriebsausgaben abgezogen werden dürfen

figures.item: § 8b(4) KStG: DIVIDENDS are fully taxable for a corporate shareholder whose DIRECT holding at the START of the calendar year was LESS THAN this share of the capital. Buying at least this share during the year counts as held from the start. The test is for dividends only, NOT for gains on a sale.
figures.quote: unmittelbar weniger als 10 Prozent des Grund- oder Stammkapitals betragen hat

figures.item: Corporate tax allowance, § 24 KStG: taken off the income of certain taxable bodies such as associations and foundations, at most the income. NOT for a GmbH, AG or any body whose distributions are dividends for the recipient, and not for investment funds.
figures.quote: ist ein Freibetrag von 5 000 Euro, höchstens jedoch in Höhe des Einkommens

figures.item: Late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag), § 152(5) AO: PER STARTED MONTH of delay, this share of the assessed tax; for annual returns, of the assessed tax LESS prepayments and creditable withholding. § 152(8): this formula does NOT apply to monthly or quarterly VAT advance returns or to wage tax returns, where the office sets the amount by discretion. It is a surcharge, not interest.
figures.quote: 0,25 Prozent der festgesetzten Steuer

figures.item: Late filing surcharge, § 152(5) sentence 1 AO: minimum PER STARTED MONTH of delay for returns that are NOT annual returns. For annual returns such as income tax the higher minimum applies (pack id de.ao.late-filing.minimum.annual).
figures.quote: mindestens jedoch 10 Euro für jeden angefangenen Monat

figures.item: Late filing surcharge, § 152(5) sentence 2 AO: minimum PER STARTED MONTH of delay for returns that relate to a calendar year or a fixed date, for example the income tax, corporate tax and annual VAT return. § 152(3): the AUTOMATIC surcharge does not apply where the deadline was extended, or the tax is set at zero or a negative amount; the office then decides by discretion. The same amount is the flat monthly surcharge for declarations to fix the trade tax base and for separate determinations (§ 152(6)).
figures.quote: mindestens jedoch 25 Euro für jeden angefangenen Monat

figures.item: Late filing surcharge for declarations of income that is determined separately (for example a partnership's return), § 152(7) AO: per started month, this share of the POSITIVE SUM of the income determined, with the monthly minimum of pack id de.ao.late-filing.minimum.annual.
figures.quote: 0,0625 Prozent der positiven Summe der festgestellten Einkünfte

figures.item: Late filing surcharge, § 152(10) AO: highest amount for one return; the surcharge is rounded down to full euros.
figures.quote: darf höchstens 25 000 Euro betragen

figures.item: Late payment surcharge (Säumniszuschlag), § 240(1) AO: PER STARTED MONTH, this share of the overdue tax rounded DOWN to the next amount divisible by the figure in pack id de.ao.late-payment.rounding. Not charged for a delay of up to three days (words in the statute); that grace does not apply to payments under § 224(2) no. 1 AO. Not charged on ancillary charges such as surcharges and interest. Never annualise it.
figures.quote: ein Säumniszuschlag von 1 Prozent des abgerundeten rückständigen Steuerbetrags

figures.item: § 240(1) AO: the overdue tax is rounded down to the next amount divisible by this figure before the late payment surcharge is computed. The same rounding step is printed in § 238(2) AO for interest.
figures.quote: abzurunden ist auf den nächsten durch 50 Euro teilbaren Betrag

figures.item: Interest on tax ARREARS AND REFUNDS after an assessment (§ 233a AO), § 238(1a) AO: PER MONTH, for interest periods from 1 January 2019. ONLY for § 233a cases. Interest on deferral, evasion and suspended enforcement follows § 238(1), which prints its monthly rate in WORDS ('einhalb Prozent'): no allowed page prints that as a digit, so write it in words.
figures.quote: 0,15 Prozent für jeden Monat

figures.item: The yearly form of the § 233a interest rate, as § 238(1a) AO itself prints it. Only for § 233a cases.
figures.quote: das heißt 1,8 Prozent für jedes Jahr

figures.item: Income tax prepayments, § 37(5) EStG: set only if they are at least this amount PER CALENDAR YEAR AND at least the amount in pack id de.income-tax.prepayment.min-date per due date. The four due dates are dates, not figures.
figures.quote: mindestens 400 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Income tax prepayments, § 37(5) EStG: minimum PER DUE DATE (second condition, AND). The same amount is the minimum for a later increase per due date.
figures.quote: mindestens 100 Euro für einen Vorauszahlungszeitpunkt betragen

figures.item: Income tax prepayments, § 37(5) sentence 2 with § 37(4) EStG: prepayments are increased AFTER the end of the year only if the increase is at least this amount; it is added to the last prepayment and due within one month of the notice.
figures.quote: im Fall des Absatzes 4 auf mindestens 5 000 Euro beläuft

figures.item: Tax-law bookkeeping duty, § 141(1) no. 1 AO: commercial businesses and farmers not already bound by other law must keep books if, per business, total turnover (as defined in § 19(2) UStG) was MORE THAN this amount in the calendar year. Joined by OR with the profit test (pack id de.ao.bookkeeping.profit). The duty starts ONLY after the tax office's notice, from the business year that follows it. The section names commercial businesses and farmers only; liberal professions are not named.
figures.quote: von mehr als 800 000 Euro im Kalenderjahr

figures.item: Tax-law bookkeeping duty, § 141(1) no. 4 AO: PROFIT from the commercial business of more than this amount in the BUSINESS YEAR. OR test with the turnover limit; duty only after the tax office's notice. The same number is printed again for farm profit, measured per calendar year.
figures.quote: einen Gewinn aus Gewerbebetrieb von mehr als 80 000 Euro im Wirtschaftsjahr

figures.item: Cheap letting of a HOME, § 21(2) sentence 1 EStG: if the rent is LESS THAN this share of the local market rent, the letting is split into a paid and an unpaid part and costs are deductible only for the paid part. Housing only: the sentence is about letting a home for living in.
figures.quote: weniger als 50 Prozent der ortsüblichen Marktmiete

figures.item: Cheap letting of a HOME, § 21(2) sentence 2 EStG: if the rent for a PERMANENT let is AT LEAST this share of the local rent, the let counts as fully paid and all costs are deductible. BETWEEN the two shares the STATUTE prints no rule. The ELSTER instructions for the 2025 return (Anlage V, lines 87 and 88) do: with rent of at least the lower share and less than this share, costs need not be split ONLY IF no loss is expected over the period of the let (surplus forecast, Überschussprognose). Both sides of the ratio include running costs that can be passed on (Umlagen). The result of a NEGATIVE forecast is only implied there: a Guide states no outcome for it and tells the accountant to check. Source year of those instructions: 2025.
figures.quote: mindestens 66 Prozent der ortsüblichen Miete

figures.item: Works soon after buying a building, § 6(1) no. 1a EStG: repair and modernisation costs within THREE YEARS after purchase become part of the building's cost (depreciated, not expensed) if, WITHOUT VAT, they EXCEED this share of the BUILDING's purchase cost (building only, not land). A cliff over the whole three years: one euro over reclassifies all of it. Extensions and yearly routine maintenance are not counted.
figures.quote: ohne die Umsatzsteuer 15 Prozent der Anschaffungskosten des Gebäudes übersteigen

figures.item: Other income from services, § 22 no. 3 EStG (the statute's examples: occasional commissions, letting movable things; the ministry's crypto letter of 6 March 2025 applies the same limit to private block-creation income, counted TOGETHER with other income from services): NOT taxable if it was LESS THAN this amount in the calendar year. A CLIFF on the net income: at or above it the whole amount is taxed. Per person. SEPARATE from the private sales limit of § 23 (pack id de.s23.limit): the two are never added together. Losses here offset only the same kind of income.
figures.quote: weniger als 256 Euro im Kalenderjahr betragen haben

figures.item: Withholding tax on NON-RESIDENTS, § 50a(2) EStG: on GROSS receipts from performances in Germany (artistic, sporting, entertainment), their exploitation, and licence and know-how fees. Withheld at source. § 50a(3): for performances, their exploitation and board fees (NOT licence fees) the payer may deduct directly related, proven expenses, but only for EU or EEA nationals resident there; the rate on that net amount is then higher for a natural person (the section prints it) and this rate for a corporation.
figures.quote: Der Steuerabzug beträgt 15 Prozent

figures.item: § 50a(2) EStG: withholding on fees paid to NON-RESIDENT supervisory board members, on gross receipts.
figures.quote: beträgt er 30 Prozent der gesamten Einnahmen

figures.item: § 50a(2) sentence 3 EStG: no withholding on performance income if the receipts PER PERFORMANCE do not exceed this amount. Performances only, not licences.
figures.quote: wenn die Einnahmen je Darbietung 250 Euro nicht übersteigen
